biggest_catch: Both cards arrive only after the referred friend becomes a new AmeriGas customer AND takes their first propane delivery — the payout is delayed and uncertain until delivery happens.
catches: $100 each side is for new residential HEATING customers only; other residential customer types pay $50 each side.
Prepaid VISA debit cards, not cash or a direct bill credit.
Cards are issued only after the referred friend takes their first delivery from AmeriGas — no partial credit for quotes or sign-ups.
Friend must have a propane-powered home in AmeriGas service territory.
Propane supply pricing varies by plan; compare the plan rate against alternatives before switching.

steps: Go to the AmeriGas Residential Referral Program page.
Complete and submit the referral form with your friend's information.
Your friend becomes a new AmeriGas residential customer.
Your friend takes their first propane delivery from AmeriGas.
You and your friend each receive the VISA pre-paid debit card ($100 for heating customers, $50 for other residential types).
